shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v "^./.git/" | head -50

cat app/page.tsx; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/ | grep -i refresh; grep -rl "refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/refresh.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "export.*refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && \
echo "--- initial page:" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently <!-- -->[^.]*' ; \
ID=$(node -e "const m=require('./.next/server/server-reference-manifest.json'); const ids=Object.keys(m.node||{}); console.log(ids[0])") && echo "action id: $ID" && \
echo "--- action response status/headers:" && curl -s -o /tmp/action.out -D - -X POST http://localhost:3123/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data '[]' | grep -iE "^(HTTP|location|x-action)" ; \
echo "--- action payload contains refreshed page?" && grep -o 'Notifications are currently[^.]*' /tmp/action.out | head -1; \
echo "--- page after toggle:" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently <!-- -->[^.]*'; \
pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; true

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && \ echo "--- initial:" && curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE '[a-z]+' ; \ ID=$(node -e "const m=require('./.next/server/server-reference-manifest.json'); console.log(Object.keys(m.node)[0])") && \ curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3124/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data '[]' && \ echo "--- after 1st toggle:" && curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE '[a-z]+' ; \ curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3124/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data '[]' && \ echo "--- after 2nd toggle:" && curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE '[a-z]+' ; \ pkill -f "next start -p 3124"; true
